title: Activity assignments
description: Who performs each activity of the activity catalog in this venture, and whether a person approves it first (EE-172). A person's decided answer to an activity proposal is merged into it (packages/naive/src/engine/activity-proposals.ts). The file is operations/activity-assignments.json.

performer.description: Who performs the activity: an agent, with a person checking a sample of the results, or a person

approval.description: Whether a person approves the activity each time before it is done
